newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht weakens late, interbank rate lower.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht weakens late, interbank rate lower.

text.p: The baht was weaker against the dollar in late trade on Wednesday after the U.S. unit rebounded abroad, dealers said.
The baht was down to 25.940/25.950 to the dollar late from 25.918/25.923 in early morning trade, dealers said.
"The market tracked the dollar's trend in overseas markets. But the market was quiet ahead of the release of the U.S. consumer price index," said one dealer at foreign bank.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the mid-rate at 25.93 per dollar against 25.97 on Tuesday.
The overnight interbank rate fell further to 7.50-8.00 percent near the close from 8.75-9.00 percent in the morning on some inflow of foreign funds, dealers said.
"There was some foreign inflow. The dollar was heavily sold especially in the swap market," one money market dealer said.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium fell to 8.50/9.50 satangs per dollar late compared with 9.00/9.50 earlier and 10.50/11.00 late on Tuesday.
